surfaces: ee swarm work-packet (drift posture consumed via the brief collector)
support bundles / handoff capsules (drift posture summaries)
unsafe-claim planner (classified as resource_admission, not memory_source_drift)

trigger.description: A database-level open or read-snapshot contention failure blocks memory-drift collection before evidence inspection. Since bd-3sh42, the genuine read-only collector does not join the application workspace write-owner flock, so merely holding .ee/ee.write.lock must not trigger this code. The defensive classification remains for lower-layer database contention errors and imported source-authority snapshots. It stays distinct from memory_drift_source_unverifiable, which means evidence was inspected but could not be verified.
setup_commands: inject or reproduce a lower-layer database open/read-snapshot contention error; a workspace write-owner flock alone is insufficient after bd-3sh42
